guidance.bestFor: The 3 variant shapes stacked with no icons: a plain line, a labeled divider and a line ruled underneath

whenNotToUse.when: A bare rule under a section heading, or a centered label over a form divider

name: c-marker-2
title: Tool call log with icon markers
label: Tool Call Log
description: Tool call log with icon markers

guidance.bestFor: A bare column of 6 tool calls, each led by an icon for its action, with no card, status or grouping
agentNotes: `TOOL_CALLS` is sample data; map your run's tool calls onto its `id`, `label` and `icon` fields

whenNotToUse.when: Steps that belong under named phases such as plan, edit and verify
A run where some steps failed or are still in progress

name: c-marker-3
title: Run status markers with a live step
label: Run Status
description: Run status markers with a live step

guidance.bestFor: A titled run card mixing done, failed and in progress rows, with a failed badge and a spinner on the live step
agentNotes: The 5 rows are written out by hand; render them from your run state and keep `role` status on the live row
`Spinner` brings its own fixed size class, so it takes `size-full` to fill `MarkerIcon` at each style's size

whenNotToUse.when: A summary of changed files with a kind badge and line counts per row
Run steps that open to their output or nest steps of their own

name: c-marker-4
title: Agent run log grouped by phase separators
label: Phase Separators
description: Agent run log grouped by phase separators

guidance.bestFor: Plan, Edit and Verify dividers splitting 8 icon steps in a run card that shows the run name and duration
agentNotes: Replace `PHASES` with your run; each phase `name` becomes a labeled divider above its `steps`
Leave `role` off the phase dividers, since a separator role is named by aria-label and drops the visible phase name

whenNotToUse.when: A short flat list of tool calls with no phase headings or card

name: c-marker-5
title: Changed files summary with border markers
label: Changed Files
description: Changed files summary with border markers

guidance.bestFor: A diff of 5 files in ruled rows: truncated monospace paths, an added, modified or removed badge and a line delta
agentNotes: `CHANGES` is sample diff data; swap in your changed files with a `path`, `kind` and `delta` each
A new `kind` goes into the union on `Change` and needs an entry in both `ICONS` and `BADGES`, since both are keyed by that union
Every row but the last takes the border `variant`, so the list never ends on a rule with nothing below it

whenNotToUse.when: A pick or drop area that sends documents, with progress per item
A colored page glyph that names each document by its extension

name: c-marker-6
title: Markers as links and as an action button
label: Links & Action
description: Markers as links and as an action button

guidance.bestFor: A pair of underlined link rows over a button row that flips between revert and undo, announced in a live region
agentNotes: Both link rows keep a placeholder `href`; point them at your pull request and diff pages
The revert row only flips local `reverted` state; call your revert action from its `onClick`

whenNotToUse.when: A standalone action or link styled as a control, outside a list of status lines
Status lines that only report what a run did, with nothing to click
